defs.def: the form of the outer edges or surfaces of sth; an example of sth that has a particular form 形状；外形；样子；呈 … 形状的事物

ex.s: English market towns come in many shapes and sizes.
ex.t: 英国的市场城镇有多种形状和大小.

ex.s: Grouping toys of different shapes.
ex.t: 组合不同形状的玩具.

ex.s: The mixture of different shapes.
ex.t: 不同形状的混合体.

ex.s: The clear front of the box had a “keyhole” in a geometric shape, and the birds were given five differently shaped “keys” to choose from.
ex.t: 盒子的清晰前方有一个几何形状的“钥匙孔”,鸟被赋予五种形状不同的“钥匙”来选择。

ex.s: This involves perceiving things like colours, shapes and movements.
ex.t: 这涉及到对颜色,形状和运动等事物的感知.

ex.s: Blind people recognize shapes with their ____40____ (exist) senses, in a way similar to that of ____41____ (sight )people, says Ella Striem-Amit, a Harvard scientist.
ex.t: 盲人用他们的40(性别)感知来识别形状, 与哈佛科学家Ella Striem-Amit相似。

ex.s: distinguish shapes                  B. make sense of human faces
ex.t: 区分形状 B. 人类的面孔

ex.s: Even trees can be art - some people are trimming trees into interesting shapes, like animals or clouds.
ex.t: 甚至树木也可以是艺术——有些人将树木修剪成有趣的形状,比如动物或云.

ex.s: The flowers are yellow and white, and shaped like trumpets.
ex.t: 花是黄色和白色的,形状像小号.

defs.def: a person or thing that is difficult to see clearly 模糊的影子

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 也许当你想到讲故事时 第一件事就是幻想之地 在你的脑海中成型 而爸爸妈妈告诉你关于王子的故事 城堡和怪物的故事

defs.def: the physical condition of sb/sth 状况；情况
the particular qualities or characteristics of sth 性质；特点
not having the normal shape 变形的；走样的

ex.s: Appropriately, the book took shape during a summer spent between sea and mountains.
ex.t: 恰当的是,这本书在海上和山区之间的一个夏天中成型。

defs.def: not in good physical condition 人

ex.s: Each has a personality shaped by the goods and services produced and traded for centuries.
ex.t: 每个人的个性都是由几个世纪以来生产和交易的商品和服务塑造的。

ex.s: I shaped individual letters into repeating lines, which were abstract forms, delightful but meaningless patterns.
ex.t: 我将单个字母塑造成重复的行,这些是抽象的形式,令人愉快但毫无意义的图案.

defs.def: to make sth into a particular shape 使成为 … 形状（或样子）；塑造

ex.s: While he held the notion that objective reality exists, he said our mind plays a necessary role in structuring and shaping our perceptions.
ex.t: 尽管他认为客观现实存在,但他说,我们的思想在构建和塑造我们的看法方面发挥着必要作用。

ex.s: How education shaped his life.
ex.t: 教育如何塑造他的生活。

ex.s: The car shaped some of the most lasting aspects of American culture: the roadside diner, the billboard, the motel, even the hamburger.
ex.t: 这辆车塑造了美国文化中一些最持久的方面:路边餐厅,广告牌,汽车旅馆,甚至汉堡.

ex.s: The shape creates a perfect market where goods could be shipped and received using the river as a highway.
ex.t: 这种形状创造了一个完美的市场,在那里,货物可以以河流为高速公路进行装运和接收。

ex.s: This form of remembered contact with a book can accompany us during a lifetime and continue to strengthen and shape us.
ex.t: 这种与一本书的记忆接触形式可以伴随我们一生,并继续加强和塑造我们.

ex.s: These social emotions prepare our brains to shape our behaviour according to the norms and values of our family and our community.
ex.t: 这些社会情感使我们的大脑做好准备,根据我们家庭和社区的规范和价值观塑造我们的行为。

ex.s: It gives us an opportunity to learn from another person’s experience and it can shape, strengthen or challenge our opinions and values.
ex.t: 它使我们有机会学习他人的经验,它能够塑造、加强或挑战我们的观点和价值观。

ex.s: Fortunately for those in midlife, Levine is finding that even if you haven't been an enthusiastic exerciser, getting in shape now may help improve your aging heart.
ex.t: 幸运的是,对于中年的人来说, 莱文发现, 即使你还没有成为一个热情的锻炼者, 现在的成形可能有助于改善你的老心。

ex.s: This ability to recognize that a shape will need to be turned in a specific direction before it will fit is called an “allocentric frame of reference”.
ex.t: 这种认识一个形状在适合它之前需要向具体方向转变的能力被称为“以大小为中心的参照框架”。

ex.s: Modern technology may help to shape the rivers’ temporal frame．
ex.t: 现代技术可能有助于塑造河流的时间框架。

ex.s: in the shape of     B. beyond the reach of
ex.t: 形状为B. 无法达到

ex.s: On Malaita, the most- populated island that’s part of the Solomon Islands, shells are accepted at most places in “How much tuna you can get for your shells depends on their color and shape,” Mary Bruno, a shop owner from the small town of Auki, on Malaita, told Vice.
ex.t: 在位于所罗门群岛部分人口最多的马莱塔岛, 贝壳在“贝壳的颜色和形状取决于你能得到多少金枪鱼”的多数地方被接受。

ex.s: With help from the artist, I managed to make one in the shape of a fish.
ex.t: 在艺术家的帮助下,我成功制作了一条鱼的形状.

ex.s: But this address to the crowd changed the minds of his people and helped shape a nation.
ex.t: 但是这个对群众的演讲改变了他的人民的思想,帮助塑造了一个国家.

ex.s: Strong winds and stormy seas have helped sculpt its long, thin shape.
ex.t: 强风和暴风海帮助雕刻出其长而薄的形状.

defs.def: to have an important influence on the way that sb/sth develops 决定 … 的形成；影响 … 的发展

ex.s: Meaning emerges through a process of social interaction, not of computation, interaction that shapes the content of the symbols in our heads.
ex.t: 意义通过一个社会互动的过程产生,而不是计算的过程,互动决定了我们头上符号的内容.

ex.s: The thing is, regular exercise to get “in shape” requires constant and considerable effort — all for gradual progress and uncertain rewards.
ex.t: 问题在于,要“成形”的经常性工作需要不断作出相当大的努力——所有这一切都是为了逐步取得进展和获得不确定的回报。

ex.s: Understanding how habits take shape may be helpful in changing bad habits.
ex.t: 了解习惯是如何形成的,可能有助于改变不良习惯。

ex.s: Back when science—then called “the new philosophy”—took shape, academics looked to craftsmen for help in understanding the natural world.
ex.t: 早在科学(当时称为 " 新哲学 " )形成时,学者们就指望工匠帮助了解自然世界。

ex.s: D．It would help shape a realistic and serious attitude to life．
ex.t: D. 这将有助于形成现实和严肃的生活态度。

defs.def: to prepare to do sth, especially hit or kick sth 准备（做某动作）；摆好姿势
to develop in a particular way, especially in a good way 进展（顺利）
to improve your behaviour, work harder, etc. 改善（行为、工作等）
